# CityMETER · School

> Recorded students and school records across Thailand by district (เขต/อำเภอ), with school group and affiliation, grades taught, published annual tuition, the ONESQA external-assessment result, OPEC enrolment history for private schools, straight-line distance to rail stations (CityMETER Transit), a comparison set per school, and learning-service places (tutoring, language, arts, child development) from the OPEC nonformal-school register. A Landometer CityMETER public demo, release 0.2.0 (2026-11-06). Research master checked 2026-10-31, schools read and built 2026-11-05 (re-read 2026-11-06, unchanged); learning services read and built 2026-11-06.

What one figure means:
- students = Σ student_count of CityMETER School 2026 (positive values only; a child development centre counts its registered children). Not seats, capacity, demand, an enrolment rate or school-age population. Unknown students are counted apart, never as 0.
- records (แห่ง) = one CityMETER school UUID of the 2026 baseline (02_SCHOOLS or 03_CHILD_CENTERS of the research master). Operation is not field-verified; not a census.
- groups = presentation groups from the source's affiliation and institution category: public (OBEC/สพฐ.), local (อปท., Bangkok, Pattaya), private (OPEC/สช.), international (an OPEC international record linked by id — never read from a name), vocational, non-formal (สกร.), child development centres, other public.
- levels = from the source's grade codes, which exist for OBEC schools only; every other record is “level unknown”.
- tuition = THB per student per academic year, tuition only, as the school announced it, per school only (86 schools). Not the cost of a year, a price level or a quality level; never summed or averaged across schools.
- assessment = the ONESQA result the sheet selected (B.E. 2564–2567), verbatim, with its year. Not a ranking.
- history = OPEC private-school snapshots, semesters 1–2 of B.E. 2565–2567. Not 2026 figures.
- distances = straight lines between reference points, not walking routes, travel times, school zones or catchments.
- districts = CityMETER production districts (codes as in https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter/{province}/D/{district}?d=school).
- learning (เรียนเสริม, the third measure) = one record of the research master's 27_LEARNING_SERVICES: an OPEC nonformal-school code the research team classed as tutoring, language, arts or child development (3,494) or a provider-confirmed point (1). A licence record, not a place verified to teach today; counted apart from the school records and never added to them; services overlap (a record may carry several); no learner counts or course prices. Pins only where the registry point lies inside the listed district (680).

Snapshot (release 0.1.0; fixtures, recompute from data):
- 40,828 records, 10,134,747 students recorded (40,338 records with known students), all 928 districts, 77 provinces; 33,078 records with a registry point.
- Bangkok: 12% of the province's recorded students (106,163 of 916,683) are in Lat Krabang, Sai Mai and Bang Kapi; 1% of their students with a point lie within 500 m of an operating rail station, against 17% in the rest of Bangkok.
- The district with the most students recorded: Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima (93,597), more than any Bangkok district.
- Learning services: 3,495 records in 350 districts of 76 provinces; Bangkok holds 960, 22% of them (207) in Pathum Wan, Khlong Toei and Prawet; Mueang Chiang Mai holds the most of any district (95).

Deep links (https://montri-th.github.io/school/):
- ?metric=count — measure records instead of students · ?metric=learning — learning-service records · ?service={tutor|language|arts|child} (with metric=learning)
- ?province={code} — e.g. BKK, NMA, CMI (production codes)
- ?area={district code} — e.g. 1039 (เขตวัฒนา)
- ?areas={code},{code} | ?areas=all — focus districts / every district
- ?group={public|local|private|international|vocational|nonformal|childcare|other} · ?level={kinder|primary|lower|upper|unknown} · ?size={z1…z6} · ?aff={affiliation code, e.g. 113}
- ?school={CityMETER school UUID} · ?learn={learning record key} · ?station={CityMETER Transit station id} · ?view={areas|mix|affs} · ?search={text}

Data and method:
- [Product statement](https://montri-th.github.io/school/PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md): users, problem, claim boundary
- [Data and method](https://montri-th.github.io/school/DATA_METHOD.md): sources, measures, groups, district matching, context joins, limits
- [Dataset](https://montri-th.github.io/school/data/schools.json): columnar rows + dictionaries + provenance (meta)
- [Learning services](https://montri-th.github.io/school/data/learning.json): columnar rows + services + provenance (meta)
- [Developer handoff](https://montri-th.github.io/school/handoff/START_HERE.md)

Map reading: symbol area grows with recorded students (hollow = unknown); names near the middle of the view rank by recorded students and published tuition; terrain facts describe the ground at hilly sites; choosing a school with a point opens a two-point perspective of a 3D building — the drawn building whose outline holds the pin, else the nearest drawn building within 300 m (800 m when nothing is drawn within 300 m), labelled “อาคารใกล้หมุด”, a camera choice, not a claim that the school is in it. Buildings per area: the units of CityMETER · Hotel (CityMETER Building V4 where it holds at least 1.15 × the OpenStreetMap buildings of a local administration it evaluated, else OpenStreetMap; data/building-units/).

Ask Google: every view links to a Google Search for the question of the view (Google answers it at the top with an AI Overview). Google's answers are not CityMETER data and are never copied into it.

Do not claim from this data: that a learning record is open today or how many learn there, a course price, school quality or rank today, seats or vacancies, demand, school-age population, enrolment rates, market share, revenue, the full cost of a year, school zones, that a school is open today, walking time, that a district without records has no schools, that a record without tuition is free, or that a building height is measured (CityMETER heights are model estimates).
